# Glossy (2024) — The DTC Nail Care Report

Trade coverage of the direct-to-consumer **nail** category, used as evidence for
[[At-Home Nail Care Disruption]].

## Key claims

- At-home gel and press-on kits captured share from basic salon manicures.
- [[Olive and June]] led the DTC-to-retail transition in the category.

`(Source: Glossy — medium confidence)`
